meta.title: Leonida Legend — GTA VI Trophy Guide & Tracker

facts.playthroughs: 1 — everything is single-player, there are no online trophies
facts.missables: One potential missable: Positive Mental Attitude (see its guide)
facts.missionReplay: None. Keep a manual save at the start and end of every chapter — the game has 15 manual slots plus 1 autosave
facts.cheats: Cheats disable both trophies and saving (PowerPyx). They only unlock after the story, which is exactly when most cleanup happens — keep them off your platinum save

meta.listNote: This is the PS5 trophy list as published in the platform catalogs and reported by Exophase, cross-checked across PowerPyx, Push Square, GTADB, GamesRadar+ and KeenGamer between 18 and 21 November 2026. Rockstar has not published a separate list of its own. One grade is disputed: Maximum Withdrawal is Silver in the PowerPyx / Insider Gaming / GTADB count (6 Silver, 46 Bronze) and Bronze in Push Square's count (5 Silver, 47 Bronze); this guide follows the majority. Five trophies were still unsolved in launch week — their guides say so and mark the community reading as unconfirmed.

roadmap.title: Story and side missions
points: Play the campaign and take optional missions as they appear (purple icons, and black icons with pink letters). Everything you do before the ending already counts toward the 100% checklist, even though you cannot view it yet.
In Chapter 1, do the balcony meditation with Lucia at Jason's house the morning she suggests it — it may be required for Positive Mental Attitude and it cannot be repeated later.

WAiNK-scan every new vehicle you come across and study animals through your binoculars: 100% will ask for 200 of the 277 vehicle models and 100 of the 255 animals, and studying is enough — you do not have to hunt them.
Keep a manual save at the start and end of each chapter. There is no mission replay, so chapter-boundary saves are your only insurance.

roadmap.title: The 100% checklist and Challenges
points: After the ending, a 100% Completion entry appears under Progress > Stats. It is closer to 60% of everything in the game: most side quests are not required and collectibles only partly.
Required in full: every robbery, underwater discovery, shooting range, drone race and Bret quest. Of the 80 Challenges only 70 are needed, so skip the ten nastiest.

Also needed: 15 of the 18 collectible card sets, 200 of 277 vehicles, 100 of 255 animals. Most single trophies (Master of None, Whip It Good, Maximum Withdrawal…) pop on their own along the way, because the checklist asks for more than they do.

roadmap.title: Strangers & Freaks and cleanup
points: The 100% checklist does not ask for the stranger strands, so the 8 strands for Strangers & Freaks are usually what is left, together with any stray trophy that did not pop on its own.
Work the filters in this tracker: sort what remains by kind, clear it group by group, and the platinum — Vice Got a Price! — unlocks with your last trophy.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum itself. It unlocks the moment every other trophy on this list is yours, so treat it as a progress check rather than a task: at 54 of 55, the one you are missing is never this one. No multiplayer, DLC or online play is involved anywhere in the list.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Story trophy for finishing Gone Fishing, the opening mission. It pops on its own as you play the campaign and cannot be missed.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Story trophy for finishing Chapter 1. Automatic as you play the campaign. Before you leave the chapter, make sure you did the balcony meditation at Jason's house (see Positive Mental Attitude) and keep a manual save.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Story trophy for finishing Chapter 2. Automatic as you play the campaign; the name is censored in the official list itself.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Story trophy for finishing Chapter 3. Automatic as you play the campaign.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Story trophy for finishing Chapter 4. Automatic as you play the campaign.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Story trophy for finishing the final mission. Free roam continues after the ending and the 100% Completion checklist appears under Progress > Stats, so nothing else on this list has to be done before you finish the story.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Story trophy for the mission Breakfast Run, played during Chapter 2. Automatic as you play the campaign.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Story trophy for the mission The Cartel Heist, played during Chapter 3. Automatic as you play the campaign.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Story trophy for the mission Child's Play, played during Chapter 4. Automatic as you play the campaign.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Story trophy for the mission Headliners, played during Chapter 4. Automatic as you play the campaign.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Story trophy for the mission VCIA Takedown, played during Chapter 4. Automatic as you play the campaign.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Story trophy for the mission Operation Savage Glory, played during Chapter 5. Automatic as you play the campaign.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: The hardest trophy on the list. After the story, a 100% Completion checklist appears under Progress > Stats — but despite the name it asks for roughly 60% of everything: all robberies, underwater discoveries, shooting ranges, drone races and Bret's quests in full; 70 of the 80 Challenges; 200 of the 277 base vehicle models scanned; 100 of the 255 animals studied through binoculars; 15 of the 18 collectible card sets. Reported checklist counts include 39 gang operations, 22 bank jobs, 7 payday loan jobs, 8 bank vault robberies, 33 underwater discoveries and 100 Cocaine Flamingos. Budget about 100 hours for this step alone and work it straight from the in-game checklist.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete any 50 of the game's 80 Challenges (Progress > Challenges). The 100% checklist wants 70, so aim past 50 anyway and leave the ten nastiest challenges in the game untouched.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete any 250 of the 397 stunts scattered over Leonida: 130 stunt jumps, 202 under-bridge flights, 40 knife flights and 25 base jumps. You need a little over half, so cherry-pick the easy jumps and base jumps first. Track them under Touch Pad > Exploration > Stunt Spots and Progress > Activities > Stunts.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once: fishing, hunting, golf, a shooting range, pool, basketball, a video game, a race and a stunt. A single attempt at each is enough — you do not have to win any of them.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn gold in all 42 shooting-range challenges. Push Square names two ranges — Rodgers Ranch & Shooting Range in Port Gellhorn and Griffin Shooting Range in Balsero — with challenges in several difficulty tiers, some locked behind other conditions. Find them under Touch Pad > Activities > Shooting Ranges. Every range is also required in full by the 100% checklist, so this work is never wasted.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at each of the 14 locations. Some races charge an entry fee, so bring cash. Locations you have found are listed under Touch Pad > Activities > Drones > Top Fun Drones, and every drone race is also required by the 100% checklist.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races out of the 40 in the game — winning the same race 20 times does not count. Hired cars are fine; if you bring your own, watch its Rating and improve it at a Mod Shop. Track race locations under Touch Pad > Activities > Racing.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Cal's questline starts in Chapter 1. Early on he asks you to catch a Parrotfish over 2 kg: take a boat with a fishing rod (there are plenty nearby to borrow), fish the marked area, and land one that is big enough to beat him.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Beat any one of the game's 4 video games. Three of them are on the TV at home, so this can be done without leaving the house.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: UNCONFIRMED — the official description is a riddle and guides disagree on the method. PowerPyx reads it as maxing out Strength for Jason and Lucia at the same time; Push Square reads it as reaching maximum body fat (Overweight). Either way, the gym is the place to work on it, and going together helps: while one character works out, the other trains automatically, so progress doubles.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish Andy's strand: 5 quests, played as Lucia, available from Chapter 3. The trophy pops when his final mission is done.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton's strand: clear 7 shipwrecks for him, starting in Chapter 1. His final mission is Maritime Disputes. Kenton can go quiet for a while in the middle of the strand — that is normal, not a bug; he comes back.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's strand: 5 quests at the Thrillbilly Mudclub, available from Chapter 2. His final mission is Hometown Heroes.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 full stranger mission strands — whole strands, not 8 individual missions. The 100% checklist does not ask for these, so they are usually the last big block left in the cleanup step of the roadmap. Every character tied to a trophy is still around in free roam after the ending.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Finish Randy's strand: deliver all 16 cars on his Wish List, available from Chapter 3. The trophy pops when his final mission is done.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's strand: played as Jason, available from Chapter 3. Destroy the Kitty Litter labs along the way and the trophy pops at his last quest.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Played as Jason: hunt the unique animal Bret asks for. Which exact animal it is was still being confirmed in launch week, so follow Bret's quest markers rather than a named species. Bret's quests are required in full by the 100% checklist, so you will be doing this work anyway.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 Meditation Spots — and wait for the closing 'zen' animation, because a meditation only counts once it has fully played. POTENTIALLY MISSABLE: one morning in Chapter 1, after an early mission, Lucia mentions meditation in the kitchen at Jason's house and heads out to the balcony. Follow her and accept the prompt. It raises the meditation counter, but the balcony is not marked as a Meditation Spot like the others, it cannot be repeated after Chapter 1, and guides have not yet confirmed whether the trophy requires it. Do it anyway, and keep a manual save before leaving Chapter 1. Track progress under Progress > Collections > Exploration > Meditations.

trophies.name: Don’t Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete any 3 of the 18 Collectible Card sets. The 100% checklist needs 15 sets, so this pops on its own along the way. Cards you have collected can be sold at Pawn Shops and still count toward your progress. Track sets under Progress > Collections > Collectible Cards.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Scan 100 locations with the WAiNK phone app (hold Up on either character's phone). Push Square counts 31 landmarks, 35 curiosities and 23 sculptures, plus No Flusher tags — more than the 100 you need. Track progress under Progress > Collections > WAiNK Locations. While you explore, also scan every new vehicle you find: that feeds Whip It Good and the 100% checklist, not this counter.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 different vehicles. A vehicle counts as discovered when you get into it or scan it with WAiNK, so this happens naturally if you scan as you go. The 100% checklist wants 200 of the 277 base models, so keep scanning after this pops. Check your count under Progress > Vehicles.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore the whole state — read by guides as clearing the fog from the entire Leonida map. Drive, fly and sail every region until no fog is left. It pairs well with stunt, WAiNK and collectible cleanup, which send you to the same corners of the map.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you, earn a 4-star wanted level and lose it completely. Robbing a bank vault gives you 4 stars instantly, so this often pops during Maximum Withdrawal runs. A reliable escape is the train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County: police struggle to follow along the tracks and the helicopter loses sight of you. The trophy unlocks once you leave the red heat zone.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops in a row with your partner while staying wanted the whole time — if the wanted level drops between shops, the chain breaks. The three jewelry stores in the north of Vice City work well. The trophy is delayed and can pop about half a minute after you leave the third store, so do not reset if it seems late.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies during one Combat Focus. Prepare first: raise your focus beforehand with food, drinks or a shower at home, bring Adrenaline, and use an assault rifle. Pick gang members at one of their illegal operations — reports say the takedowns do not register on soldiers, police or civilians.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Steal an airliner docked at a boarding bridge at VCIA (Vice City International Airport) and fly it 1 km away from the airport. The easiest one is docked at terminals E3/E4.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: The description is a riddle — a Rhino is a tank. The reported method is to steal a tank at Mile Zero Air Station. Treat that as the community reading of the hint rather than a spelled-out requirement.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. You need the Snap Gun, which only becomes available in Chapter 3. Keep a manual save before the attempt so a blown cover costs you nothing.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob any 5 of the 8 bank vaults in the game and get away clean each time. All robberies are required by the 100% checklist anyway, and a vault robbery instantly earns a 4-star wanted level — a good moment to also earn Hot Together with your partner. Grade note: PowerPyx, Insider Gaming and GTADB list this trophy as Silver; Push Square's list shows it as Bronze. That single disagreement is why the published grade splits differ (6 Silver / 46 Bronze vs 5 Silver / 47 Bronze).

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape the police afterwards. Armored trucks are part of the robbery set the 100% checklist requires, so this normally pops on its own during the checklist step.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs. There are 39 operations in total, and the 100% checklist requires the robbery set in full, so this pops on the way. Gang operations are also the recommended hunting ground for Gunslinger.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates’ bowling alley.
trophies.guide: The description is a riddle, so treat this method as reported rather than spelled out: PowerPyx reads it as taking all 3 key valuables from Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn and then losing the police. No guide claims you actually bowl a game.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: The description is a riddle; the understood condition is to perform 500 actions that affect your Criminal Profile, which ordinary play accumulates on its own. One warning from PowerPyx: avoid the Irredeemable criminal profile — it is permanent and makes the police more aggressive.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder $250,000 worth of Marked Bills through your contacts (fences). Only marked bills washed this way count toward the total — ordinary income does not — so route every marked bill you pick up through a fence instead of spending it directly.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 in total across any shops — what you buy is up to you. Find shops on the map under Touch Pad > Style. Buying all 8 garages for Little Boxes costs $160,000 and carries you past this on its own.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Buy all 8 garages through the Vice City Real Estate app on your phone: Mitchel Auto Center $4,000; 7th Avenue Garage $12,000; Vela Rota Drive Garage $24,000; Persistence Road Garage $7,600; Wyatt Motors $21,600; Bonita Court Garage $34,000; Atlantic Court Garage $40,000; Store n' Bolt $16,800. That is $160,000 in total, and each garage adds 1 parking spot for registered vehicles.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 different vehicles to Scooter Bros at any Pay 'N' Spray or Mod Shop. You need a free parking spot for each one (buy garages to get more), and the registration fee scales with the vehicle's value. Registered vehicles can then be delivered to you, fully repaired, for a small fee.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: UNSOLVED in launch week — PowerPyx lists the trigger as unknown. The description points at having a cocktail somewhere with a view over Ocean Beach; until players confirm the exact spot and action, treat any specific method you read as a guess. This entry will need an update once the trigger is confirmed.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: UNSOLVED in launch week — PowerPyx lists the trigger as unknown. The description suggests getting into a car inside a vehicle showroom and driving out through the glass frontage 'in classic style', but the exact showroom and conditions are unconfirmed.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: UNSOLVED in launch week — PowerPyx lists the trigger as unknown. 'Second time's the charm' hints at succeeding at something on a second attempt after failing it once, but what the something is has not been confirmed.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: UNSOLVED in launch week — PowerPyx lists the trigger as unknown. The description hints at witnessing something strange out in Leonida. No location or event has been confirmed yet, so treat any claimed sighting spot as unverified.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl ’em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: UNSOLVED in launch week — PowerPyx lists the trigger as unknown. PowerPyx's reading of the riddle is knocking 10 pedestrians off a bike within 60 seconds using melee drive-bys; that is a community interpretation, not a confirmed method.
